theorem e2_bound {Q Q₀ s c : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q))
    (hram : ∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      |Gq d R - (Nat.totient d / d) * (Real.log R + c + Sq d)| ≤ 7.284 * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) * f1q d) :
    max 0 (-(Gq q (Q / (s * q)) - (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log (Q / (s * q)) + c + Sq q))) ≤
      7.284 * 0.03685 * (Q₀ / (s * q)) ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) * f1q q :=

provenance.method: re-judged at the pin; key relations re-judged blind, statement against statement (2026-11-12)

note: Lean's λ(q) uses constants that are worst cases over ρ ≤ 0.6, so lamQ q ≥ the book's λ(q) and regionL covers slightly fewer R. RegionL is used only for q ≥ 2.2·10¹⁰.
